x: A word of praise to our lesser lights: Allen, Bicknell, Yorwarth, Laurie, Spooner, Wattam and Willis for their efforts. Also, many thanks to the willing band of cyclists who did yeoman work as attendants.

Elson, Heather, Goold, Jarvis, Boddington, Snell Hamer, Spooner, Cornish, Joe Coleman, Earle, Urry, Clark, Pattenden, Willis, True and several others, some beginners, who are showing rapid improvement.

Lionel Spooner, whom most of us do not know personally, is keeping the "claret and gold" to the fore in Palestine. Charlie Churcher sends an intersting newspaper cutting of a 10 miles championship road walk in Jerusalem, during January.
